Players Committee card image of [[Stolen Stormtrooper Blaster Rifle]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Deploy on your Rebel or stormtrooper. May target a character, creature, or vehicle for free. Draw destiny. Add 1 if targeting a vehicle. Target hit if total destiny +1 > defense value. If hit by Chewie or a stormtrooper, target may not be used to satisfy attrition.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ee4c4cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/stolen_stormtrooper_blaster_rifle.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/stolen_stormtrooper_blaster_rifle.png] as of commit ee4c4cd “Set 15 cards + errata images” (22 June 2021).
